entries.e2b4d78f56a5cf6b: Marking the 100th anniversary of its founding in April 2025, the company plans to promote a strategic business model built around “clothing, health and housing.” In clothing, it aims to rebuild and differentiate the brand value of children’s wear; in health, it plans to expand from kindergarten child monitoring to indoor monitoring for the elderly; and in housing, it says it will build its business base on four revenue models: rentals, regeneration and resale of vacant homes, fractional real estate products, and a matching platform.
entries.ed1dc8c59afd3921: In the real estate business, its strength lies in raising the added value of used properties through renovation by Ist Group, and it focuses on the resale business. In the apparel business, it aims for product development that emphasizes originality and quality through in-house planning and design.
